posts.subject: Rainbow 6 closed beta code
posts.bodyHtml:
Ich kopiere es einfach mal hier rein, nehme an ein paar von euch wollen es mal ausprobieren.




Zitat von Gfinity.net-Mitarbeiter

How to Redeem Code:
1. Go to www.rainbow6.com/beta
2. Select "REDEEM CODE"
3. Select your platform of choice
4. Click "NEXT" to log in to Uplay, or create a Uplay account
5. Enter your unique Access Code
6. Once confirmation is received, Ubisoft will contact you with youraccess instructions for your platform of choice when the Closed Beta starts
